structured_output.summary: The change implements WeakSet.prototype.has in the order the spec gives. this_weak_set performs RequireInternalSlot (step 2) and propagates its TypeError with ?. CanBeHeldWeakly is checked before the lookup and returns false when it fails (step 3). The table lookup on collection_key(value) returns true on a hit (step 4). Otherwise it returns false (step 5). No inputs are special-cased, no errors are swallowed, and no values are invented. The only other edit is renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target, which is needed because the parameter is now unused. The helpers (can_be_held_weakly, collection_key, this_weak_set, weak_set_table) live in support::collections, which is outside the diff, so I could not check their internals. The diff itself gives no sign that they misbehave.
